item.title: Version 1.315.0
item.description:
What's New in 1.315.0

  • Hold Fn to dictate — hold the Fn (🌐) key, talk, and let go to insert the text; no more pauses ending a recording early. ⌘⇧Space still works as before. Fn pressed together with another key (Fn+←, Fn+F1) is left alone, and a press too short to hold a word is ignored. It needs Accessibility access, which priviSay already asks for to type at your cursor; it only watches the Fn key. If your 🌐 key is set to show emoji or switch input source, Preferences offers to change that, since macOS would also do it each time you let go. Turn it off in Preferences. Fn doesn't reach macOS on many non-Apple keyboards; use ⌘⇧Space there.

All transcription happens 100% locally on your device.
